description: Agent Labor Verification: submit the licenses or certifications a worker held during a work period with the work performed: the worker with the name and trade, the first and last day of the work period, each piece of work with its id, the day worked, the task, the credential type it requires and the license class it requires, and each credential with its id, type, class, number, issuer, issue date and expiry date. The signed report gives the worker, the period and the credentials, each piece of work against a credential of the type its task requires, each credential’s expiry against the work after it, the class each credential licenses against the class each task requires, and each credential’s issue date against the work it covers, and counts them, and names a divergent record: a task done with no credential of its type, work claimed after a credential expired inside the period, a license class unlike the task performed, and a credential issued after the work it covers started; then work outside the period and a credential expiring within thirty days of the period’s end, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No work, no credential type required, no credentials, or no issue or expiry dates leaves those points unverified. Credential types match by their words with licence and license read as one, classes without the words class, tier, level or grade, and dates by the day. This checks that the credential covered the dates the work was actually done: wever_hire-credential-check reads a candidate’s credentials before hiring, while the labor credential check reads the credentials held on each day of work already performed. Verdict labor_credential_divergent, labor_credential_partial, labor_credential_unverified or labor_credential_consistent. POST /api/labor-credential-check. Reads the labor records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never schedules or assigns work, never pays wages, never hires, disciplines or terminates anyone and gives no legal advice, which stay with the employer, the worker and their advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Labor Verification reads labor records for work already performed: a timesheet, a work-completion log, the licenses a worker held, an overtime claim, billed labor rates, billed labor hours, worker classification evidence and a wage record, each against the shift record, the agreed task list, the dates worked, the hours record, the rate card, the contracted labor scope, the classification claimed or the verified hours and agreed rates it answers to. The family checks hours, work, credentials and pay after the work is done; the Agent Hiring family checks decisions and documents before engagement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-labor-verification-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-labor-verification/.
